Professional Communication Essentials

The Professional Communication Essentials module equips students with essential practical experience in media creation related to business, design, and strategy, while also developing their critical thinking and analytical skills. By the end of this module, students will have a solid foundation in professional communication, preparing them for advanced communication courses at BUV.

Module Outcomes:

+  Interpret and respond to advertising/marketing briefs, considering creative practice, business strategy, and client expectations.

+  Manage media creation in a group project and evaluate the effectiveness of design concepts in varying contexts.

+  Reflect on practice and express ideas confidently through audio-visual, verbal, and written communication.

+  Gain an overview of business, design, and strategy in the creative industries.
